method: Native sinusoidal pixel centres inside rectangular extents. Area is sum of native pixel areas, about 0.21466 km² each (nominal 500 m product). QA bits 0 and 1 must be set. Burn day must fall inside the product calendar month. Shortened mapping periods (bit 2) remain in the mapped total and are disclosed separately, with a full-period-only sensitivity total. Invalid land is excluded, not assumed unburned. No boundary fractional-area correction. Product incorporates MODIS active fires and is not independent fire truth.
